title: Enchantments
summary: Every enchantment, what it applies to and what it does at its top level.

s.x: Enchantments come from the enchanting table (up to the table level shown) or as tomes. Ultimate enchants are tome-only and an item can hold just one. The effect column shows the maximum level.
